bengal.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset: one catalog/configurator pilot image of the DOUCEUR funerary monument. Image 1 is the exact monument geometry reference; image 2 is the BENGAL granite texture reference. Reproduce the complete monument from image 1 as a clean isolated studio product render. Preserve the broad upright shield-shaped headstone with convex lower sides, slightly narrowed upper sides, small sculpted upper-corner shoulders and its distinctive asymmetric gently wavy top, with the higher rounded crest left of center and lower sweep toward the right. Preserve its thick polished bevel, rear horizontal supporting block, long raised rectangular slab with softened bevelled edges, and both large curved longitudinal side rails. The side rails have broad sculpted rounded rolled-down returns at BOTH front and back, and long layered horizontal mouldings along the sides: these are essential stone structural parts. Preserve the recessed front step and wide flat rectangular plinth. Preserve all real component proportions, contours, junctions and thicknesses. Change EVERY stone component to the same BENGAL granite in image 2, charcoal grey with fine grey, white and black mineral grains at realistic stone scale. The silver-looking edges in image 1 are polished stone highlights, NOT metal inlays. Completely remove the faceted vase and white flower bouquet at front left, and also remove ALL of their reflections in the headstone, slab and base. No second vase, ghost bouquet, engraving, inscription, symbols or accessories. Reorient camera to be exactly centered on the longitudinal axis, with zero left-right yaw and front headstone face parallel to the image plane. Use parallel orthographic projection with modest camera elevation sufficient to show the long top slab and recessed front step, no three-quarter view. Front edges horizontal, left and right rails evenly presented. Entire object visible with balanced margins in a square image. Uniform pale grey studio floor and background, soft contact shadow, gentle balanced studio lighting, polished stone with restrained reflections. Do not invent or omit structural parts. Requested output 2048 x 2048. This is the fixed geometry master for nine later material-only edits.
bengal.controleVisuel: Controle visuel: stele bouclier au sommet asymetrique, petites epaules, dalle, rails courbes et retours avant/arriere, marche et plinthe presents ; vase, bouquet et leurs reflets supprimes ; cadrage stable entre variantes. Vue frontale masquant certains profils et moulures laterales ; equivalence geometrique exacte non confirmee. Perspective residuelle, non strictement orthographique. PNG original 1254 x 1254 ; calibration, echelle du grain et format final >=1600 non valides.
